page.overview:
Who is Claudia Sheed?

Claudia Sheed is a drow woman and the former owner of the Leaky Tap in Zadash. In her appearances during the campaign, she used illusion magic to disguise herself as a non-drow elven woman. As an NPC, Claudia Sheed is played by Matthew Mercer.

Using illusion magic, Claudia appeared as a non-drow elven woman, who looked to be, by human standards, in her 40’s. While working she was graceful if a bit disheveled, wearing a simple apron and having her hair pulled back and tied into a small haphazard bun. When off-duty, she wore a maroon silk robe and had her hair in a high bun.

She was not judgmental when it concerned which patron or deity a person chose to follow, even if it happened to be unsanctioned by the Dwendalian Empire, going so far as allowing the Knights of Requital to hold their meetings in the cellar of The Leaky Tap.

Claudia was a refugee from conflicts of the Kryn Dynasty. The man who owned the tavern offered to take her in, but badly mistreated her. She killed him, hid his skeleton, and got forged documents from The Gentleman to take over the tavern.
